# Building textures — credits

All textures are from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com) and are released under **CC0 1.0** (public domain).
They were downloaded at 1K, resized/re-encoded (colour and normal 1024 px JPEG, roughness 512 px greyscale JPEG).

| Files | Poly Haven asset | Author | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plaster_col.jpg`, `plaster_nrm.jpg`, `plaster_rgh.jpg` | https://polyhaven.com/a/painted_plaster_wall | Amal Kumar | CC0 |
| `sandstone_col.jpg`, `sandstone_nrm.jpg`, `sandstone_rgh.jpg` | https://polyhaven.com/a/sandstone_blocks_08 | Rob Tuytel | CC0 |
| `brick_col.jpg`, `brick_nrm.jpg`, `brick_rgh.jpg` | https://polyhaven.com/a/red_brick_03 | Rob Tuytel | CC0 |
| `concrete_col.jpg`, `concrete_nrm.jpg`, `concrete_rgh.jpg` | https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_wall_008 | Dario Barresi, Charlotte Baglioni | CC0 |
| `granite_col.jpg`, `granite_nrm.jpg`, `granite_rgh.jpg` | https://polyhaven.com/a/granite_tile | Charlotte Baglioni | CC0 |
| `rooftiles_col.jpg`, `rooftiles_nrm.jpg`, `rooftiles_rgh.jpg` | https://polyhaven.com/a/roof_09 | Rob Tuytel | CC0 |
| `slate_col.jpg`, `slate_nrm.jpg`, `slate_rgh.jpg` | https://polyhaven.com/a/roof_slates_03 | Rob Tuytel | CC0 |

The shop-sign atlas (Apotheke, Bäckerei, Kiosk …) is drawn at runtime on a canvas in `src/world/buildings.js`; no files.
